<!doctype html>
<!--
  wordmark-tiles demo: standalone 1920x1080 host composition. It mounts the
  primitive through data-composition-src into a definite card instead of
  inlining primitive markup or motion. The non-default text, column count,
  and wave stagger prove that per-instance variables cross the mount.
-->
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1920, height=1080" />
    <title>Wordmark Tiles Demo</title>
    <style>
      * {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }

      html,
      body {
        width: 1920px;
        height: 1080px;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      #root {
        --bg: #070a12;
        --fg: #f5f7ff;
        --muted: #7f8aa3;
        --surface: #151b2b;
        --border: rgba(245, 247, 255, 0.14);
        --brand: #7c9dff;
        --accent: #64e2c2;
        --font-display: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
        --font-body: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
        --font-mono: ui-monospace, monospace;
        --radius: 16px;
        --space-1: 8px;
        --space-2: 16px;
        --space-3: 32px;
        --dur-beat: 0.4s;
        --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.215, 0.61, 0.355, 1);
        --ease-emphasis: cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1);
        --ease-exit: cubic-bezier(0.55, 0.055, 0.675, 0.19);

        position: relative;
        width: 1920px;
        height: 1080px;
        overflow: hidden;
        background: var(--bg);
        color: var(--fg);
        font-family: var(--font-body);
      }

      .mount-card {
        width: 64%;
        height: 56%;
        left: 18%;
        top: 22%;
        overflow: hidden;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 1.75);
        background: var(--surface);
        box-shadow: 0 4cqh 10cqh color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg) 12%, transparent);
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div
      id="root"
      data-composition-id="wordmark-tiles-demo"
      data-start="0"
      data-width="1920"
      data-height="1080"
      data-duration="6.5"
      data-fps="30"
    >
      <div
        id="wordmark-tiles-mount"
        class="mount-card clip"
        data-composition-id="wordmark-tiles"
        data-composition-src="data:text/html;base64,"
       
        data-start="0"
        data-duration="6.5"
        data-track-index="0"
        data-width="1229"
        data-height="605"
      ></div>
    </div>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.14.2/dist/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <script>
      // The mounted primitive owns all visible motion. This standalone host
      // registers only the empty paused timeline required for its own id.
      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["wordmark-tiles-demo"] = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
